Definition: Integration of voter registration data for identity verification, demographic analysis, and service delivery targeting
Comments: Rwanda's electoral system uses biometric national ID for voter registration (same NIDA system), but no explicit documented integration of NEC electoral data into the Data Sharing Platform under development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: NEC confirmed (KT Press, May 2024) that voter registers are electronically synchronised with NIDA's national ID database, enabling real-time verification and USSD-based updates; this bilateral integration has existed since at least 2016 (ID4Africa Rwanda ID documentation). This is more advanced than 'Planned', but full integration into the new government-wide Data Sharing Platform (still in procurement as of November 2025) is unconfirmed, so 'Partially integrated' rather than 'Fully Integrated' is used.

Definition: Integration of court records, case management systems, correctional services data, legal aid information
Comments: Rwanda Investigations Bureau (RIB) data is referenced in recruitment background checks via DSP use cases. However, formal court records/case management integration with the DSP is not documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS), operational since 2016, already links the Rwanda Investigation Bureau, National Public Prosecution Authority, Judiciary, Correctional Services, Civil Litigation Service and Bar Association on one shared case-management platform (270,000+ users); a January 2025 upgrade added NIDA and the Forensic Institute. This is well beyond 'Planned' — set to 'Partially integrated' (integration beyond the justice sector into the broader cross-government exchange is not yet confirmed); recommend human review on whether depth of sector-wide integration merits 'Fully Integrated'.

Definition: Integration of passport issuance and immigration control data into the exchange platform
Comments: NIDA biometric ID is the basis for passport systems. Immigration data shares the same biometric identity foundation. RDB (Rwanda Development Board) immigration/visa functions are integrated with NIDA. However, full passport data exchange integration into the DSP is pending.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: DGIE (immigration/passport authority) e-passport issuance requires a NIDA national ID and captures biometrics via the Irembo platform, including a dedicated system for diaspora applicants combining NIDA and DGIE processing. DGIE also runs an Advance Passenger Information data exchange with airlines under Law n°57/2018. This is real operational data exchange, not merely development — set to 'Partially integrated'; full DSP-based integration remains unconfirmed.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: RRA (Rwanda Revenue Authority) data is referenced in the National Data Sharing Policy use cases (e.g., government job applications requiring RRA compliance verification). Irembo provides online tax-related services. However, full operational data exchange integration between RRA and the DSP is pending its development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: World Bank G2P interoperability documentation for Rwanda shows RRA as one of 16 systems already interoperating via the Government Enterprise Service Bus (GESB) alongside NIDA, LODA, BNR and RSSB, used for compliance verification in government processes. This indicates functioning, if partial, integration rather than 'Under development' — set to 'Partially integrated'. Only one strong primary source found specifically naming RRA in this architecture; recommend human review to corroborate before treating as final.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: LODA (Local Administrative Entities Development Agency) manages social assistance and is one of the eight agencies studied for interoperability. MINALOC coordinates social protection linked to NIDA. Social protection data sharing is a DSP use case.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Rwanda's Imibereho Dynamic Social Registry (launched 2024) is explicitly described as interoperable with multiple government systems with on-demand data updates; World Bank documentation confirms LODA's Social Protection MIS (iSP-MIS) is functional and linked to NIDA, RRA, BNR and RSSB via the GESB for G2P payments. This is stronger than 'Under development' — set to 'Partially integrated'.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Rwanda has Data Protection and Privacy Law (No. 058/2021) and Access to Information Law in force. The National Data Sharing Policy (approved May 2025) creates a legally binding framework for inter-governmental data sharing. Electronic communications law exists. However, the interoperability study (2017) noted lack of laws requiring agencies to integrate.
redteam_note: Comment wording may not match the score — re-read (needs judgement).
revision_notes: Confirmed: Rwanda's Data Protection and Privacy Law No. 058/2021 is in force, and Cabinet approved a National Data Sharing Policy on 26 May 2025 establishing a Data Governance Unit, technology platform requirements and institutional obligations for cross-government sharing (RISA, KT Press, Cenfri, May–October 2025). The Policy is an executive/Cabinet instrument rather than an Act of Parliament, but combined with the enacted Data Protection Law this supports 'Yes' (score 3) rather than 'Under development'; score confirmed.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Connect Rwanda initiative and Digital Ambassador Program extend access to underserved populations. Irembo available in multiple languages and via mobile. Agent network provides offline/assisted access. However, full accessibility for disabled, elderly, and low-literacy populations not fully documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The originally cited RISA article covers a health-DPI conference panel and does not discuss accessibility, Digital Ambassadors, or Irembo language options — it does not actually support this score and should be replaced. Independent evidence confirms accessibility efforts are underway but incomplete: over 2,000 Digital Ambassadors deployed nationwide (TechCabal, June 2025), a National Policy on Disability and Inclusion committing to expand PWD digital access, and an independent inclusiveness assessment noting persistent gaps for elderly and disabled users. Score of 3 ('Accessibility improvements in progress') is confirmed on this stronger evidence.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Rwanda has Connect Rwanda and community-based initiatives extending digital access. Agent network for Irembo serves rural areas. However, urban-rural digital divide persists with Kigali significantly more connected than rural districts.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The originally cited RISA article does not address the urban-rural divide and does not support this score. Rwanda's National Institute of Statistics EICV7 survey (2023/24) found household internet access of 56-57% in urban areas versus only 19% in rural areas (corroborated by ITU-sourced reporting, TechCabal, June 2025); the gap is narrowing as tower coverage expands from 75% towards a targeted 97% of land area. This supports 'Partial rural coverage' (score 2) rather than equitable coverage; original source replaced with authoritative national statistics, score confirmed.
